last_summary: v1 shows ingredient gathering, rooftop cooking, and a lightning interruption; v2 shows a TV chef, an elderly woman becoming agitated and swinging a cane/shotgun, kitchen panic, and rain-driven shelter construction. The best-supported missing interval is that cooking/TV-chef activity created a disturbance that alerted the woman (B). Alternatives lack direct visible causes, though the precise noise trigger remains partly unresolved.
